verdict.summary_en: Delivery note DN-261109-802 dated 11/09/2026 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony DC Hamburg against PO 4500318751. It covers 5.640 PCS (read as 5,640) of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, in 1 package, gross weight 19 kg, carrier Alpen Air Cargo GmbH. It carries a blue RECEIVED 12.11.2026 DC-HAM stamp and a handwritten 'Schulz P.' under Received by. There are no corrections, remarks or inspection outcomes.
observations: Quantity is printed '5.640'. I read the period as a thousands separator, so 5640, because the unit is PCS. The document does not state its own separator convention, so please verify.
Note date 11/09/2026 is in US month/day format (9 Nov 2026), which matches the DN number 261109. The stamp date 12.11.2026 is in day.month format (12 Nov 2026).
Blue RECEIVED stamp is slightly rotated but fully legible.
Handwritten 'Schulz P.' appears on the Received by line; it is a signature or name only.
Remarks field is blank. The Packages column header slightly overflows the table border, which is cosmetic.
